## Live code and figures

```{r}
#| output-location: column
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4.5
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(factor(dose), len, fill = supp)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#055F56", "#0B376C")) +
  labs(x = "Dose (mg/day)", y = "Tooth length", fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16)
```
